entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Parties Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Gautam Kumar

For the Petitioner : Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate Ms. Supriya Dayal, Advocate For
the State : Mr. Vineet Kumar Vashistha, Special P.P. Order No.03 / Dated :13.09.2024

The
anticipatory bail application filed on behalf of petitioner, who is apprehending her arrest in
connection with Nawajaipur P.S. Case No. 45 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 406
and 420 of the Indian Penal Code pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class,
Palamau at Daltonganj, is pressed into motion.
As per the FIR, informant had taken Rs.30,000/- and Rs.40,000/- loan from Utkarsh Finance Bank and Bandhan Bank respectively.
The petitioner undertook to repay her amount to the Bank along with Chandan Kumar and Niraj Kumar who were Collection Agent of the Bank.
34 persons who had to repay the amount to the Bank, were also made the same offer.

It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of the petitioner that it has not been stated in the FIR that the informant had paid any amount to this petitioner and the only allegation is that she gave an undertaking that she will not be required to make repayment to the Bank which was not honored and Bank pressurized the informant to make the payment.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the submissions made, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned Trial Court within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order before the learned court below and in the event of her arrest or surrender, she shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below,
subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
